text: RELEASE IS THE LAST STEP. After final dev walkthrough and Andrey approval, cut a real release via develop->master PR, version bump+sync, release-X.Y.Z tag, and three-runner farm so prod receives keepawake self-heal, pair-flow v2, and all merged fixes. Keepawake is not user-visibly done until this ships.

SCOPE ADDITION (fidelity audit, round-23 — encodes Andrey's standing mandates that lived only in messages): (1) RELEASE IS THE FINAL STEP of this plan: after the walkthrough passes and Andrey approves, cut a release (develop->master PR flow, version bump + sync, release-X.Y.Z tag, three-runner farm) so PROD ships everything — explicitly verify post-release that prod keepawake self-heal works (his Mac slept twice on the unpatched prod; the task is not user-visibly done until prod is patched). (2) Walkthrough additions from later rounds: restart-recovery item (plan entry visible <3s after dev restart, bcf638f8), round-18 pair items (virtual picker tab: no PTY until confirm, excluded from session snapshot; DropdownMenu everywhere, no native selects, no flicker), guide reflects subordination (orchestrator-led hierarchy figure). (3) Plan retrospective written via plan retrospective CLI as the closing stride, including plan-skills promotion review.

PUCCINI SELF-REFLECTION (round-40, verbatim distillation — feeds the plan retrospective): WENT WELL — multi-agent routing when disciplined (Dali lanes clean), gate quality up (focused tests/scenarios/screenshots/sha reports), bounce-don't-rewrite preserved context, P0 specs now executable. WENT WRONG — slipped into implementer mode under urgency (sidebar/chat hotfix); too much unrelated work in one integration window; accepted almost-green lanes with deferred evidence that Andrey later caught live; task bodies not proactively pasted cross-mesh; dirty integration checkout (WIP + prompt edits mixed). IMPROVES — default to dispatch/gate/bounce; scratch worktree for any inspection; P0/P1 visual tasks require screenshot compare + selector assertions + live dogfood before merge; full task bodies at dispatch; explicit lane tracking (owner/branch/base-sha/status/blocker/next-gate); skipped Playwright assertions = OPEN RISK unless user accepts substitute; no concern-mixing across lanes. NET: system works when the orchestrator acts like one.

PLANNER TRIAGE (round-53): this task stays BLOCKED deliberately — it is the plan's closing user gate (live dev walkthrough by Andrey + wrap-up), sequenced by design after: both mesh regressions close, GH burn-down closes, develop PR merges, release prep stages the build Andrey will test. Blocked here means 'sequenced last, waits on prerequisites + the user', not 'stuck'. UNBLOCK TRIGGER (explicit, so it does not rot): when release-prep (task_cbfaa040) reaches in_review, Puccini flips this to pending and requests Andrey's walkthrough — that is the endgame handoff moment.

UNBLOCK TRIGGER UPDATED (round-90): the walkthrough now flips to pending when the FINAL STAGING task completes (dev consoles live on Air+ROG+ubunta at one pinned sha, full regression green everywhere, keepawake on, handoff table delivered) — Andrey tests on all three machines, not just Air. Teardown of the consoles is Andrey's call after his sign-off.

RETROSPECTIVE STEP MADE EXPLICIT (round-97, Andrey verification — the task body's wrap-up list never named the retrospective; the automatic PLAN_RETROSPECTIVE_NUDGE exists in code, but the human checklist must carry it too). ADDED to this task's wrap-up sequence, after Andrey's approval and BEFORE archive: run 'codeterm plan retrospective' synthesizing the recorded inputs — this plan accumulated an unusually rich retro corpus, inventoried here so nothing is lost: (1) Puccini's self-reflection (round-40) + Planner's critical evaluation with the three flaws and generalization limits; (2) the polling/shell-gate incident analysis + affordance-asymmetry root cause; (3) the state-drift retro (claims-vs-observations, four gaps, meta root cause: recording system vs supervised state machine); (4) the shared-checkout retro (isolation-was-prose, alarm-fatigue-by-design, adoption debt x3); (5) the section-bloat retro (convenience linking, third-task rule); (6) the orchestrator token audit (yield-watching, narration diet, turn-count economics); (7) the handoff rehearsal findings (Puccini->Rossini: what transferred cleanly, the planner-relink gap); (8) skills-adoption gap (built-but-unused pattern, three occurrences) + the skills-resurrection/sync findings. GRADUATION step per the amended nudge: proven skills/scripts promote UP — machine-wide -> codeterm mem skill, repo-shaped -> .agents/skills or scripts/ via a reviewed lane. The retrospective is a first-class deliverable of this plan, not a formality — it produced the process charter a whole product wave now encodes.
